summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour continues his discussion on the Book of Salah, focusing on the importance and virtue of making dua (supplication) between the Adhan and Iqamah. He explains how the Prophet Muhammad established this practice to give all believers an equal opportunity for reward, not just the Muezzin. Sh. Ali Mashhour emphasizes that dua made between Adhan and Iqamah is guaranteed to be answered by Allah, citing the hadith from Anas that states such duas are never rejected. He addresses a cultural problem in modern masajid where social conversations interrupt worshippers, advocating for respect and protecting this sacred time dedicated solely to worship and sincere supplication.
suggested_title: The Virtue of Dua Between Adhan and Iqamah: A Guaranteed Answer from Allah
catchy_title: Your Duas Between Adhan and Iqamah Are Never Rejected
